subject: general
question: Prabhu travelled in the east direction from his house a distance of 20 km to his friend's house. After some time he left his friend’s house and took a turn towards right and travelled 15 km to reach a park. After resting for a while, he again started and turned to right and travelled 18 km to reach a petrol bunk. From there he again turned right and covered a distance of 15 km. How many km more he has to travel to reach home?
solution:
Direction diagram can be traced as shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10d03a05f6daff3d7f529207ad8a469e850d92a7e60b0d2a9c98086ef4cd68a1.png] 

Now he needs to travel 20 km – 18 km = 2 km to reach his home.

Hence, **"2 km"** is the correct answer.
